title: Account Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 SLK Group of Companies (India) is a diversified and fast\-growing enterprise with operations across facility management, automotive manufacturing, infrastructure, renewable energy, and pharmaceuticals. The Group delivers customized facility management solutions for commercial, residential, and industrial clients, and manufactures automotive components that meet global quality standards, with plans to expand into vehicle retail and customer services. In infrastructure, SLK develops premium residential projects that combine modern design, strong construction quality, and sustainable practices. Its manufacturing portfolio includes food colors, wall paints, and street lighting systems, supporting both industrial and public infrastructure needs, while its renewable energy and pharma divisions focus on clean energy adoption and high\-quality healthcare products. Guided by customer satisfaction, technological advancement, and ethical business practices, SLK Group continues to strengthen its position as a trusted, forward\-looking business group.
 



  





  





  





 CTC :\- 6,00,000 \- 6,60,000/\- Annual
 



  





  





  





  





**Role Description** 
 The Account Manager role at SLK Group of Companies is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Pimpri Chinchwad. The individual in this role will manage relationships with key clients across the Group’s business verticals, serving as the main point of contact for inquiries, service delivery, and issue resolution. Daily responsibilities include understanding client requirements, coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely and accurate execution of services, preparing proposals and quotations, and tracking contracts and renewals. The Account Manager will monitor account performance, analyze service quality and revenue metrics, and identify opportunities for upselling and cross\-selling. The role also involves maintaining accurate records, preparing regular reports, supporting collections and credit control, and contributing to customer satisfaction initiatives and process improvements.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Client relationship management and customer service skills, with the ability to build trust, handle concerns, and maintain long\-term partnerships.
* Account management, sales coordination, and basic business development skills to manage pipelines, follow up on leads, and support revenue growth.
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation abilities for interacting with clients, internal stakeholders, and senior management.
* Organizational, time management, and documentation skills to handle multiple accounts, prioritize tasks, and maintain accurate records.
* Proficiency with MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and CRM or ERP systems, along with comfort working with data and reports.
* Understanding of at least one of the Group’s domains (facility management, automotive, infrastructure, manufacturing, renewable energy, or pharmaceuticals) is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Management, or a related field; relevant professional certifications in sales or account management are a plus.
* Ability to work on\-site in Pimpri Chinchwad, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and adapt to a dynamic, multi\-industry environment.
